title: I have concerns about using AI in my game.
author: ErenTheGameDev
selftext:
I am a solo developer and started a project around 3-4 months ago. I only have some 3d envoriment desing experience and no experience about scripting, character modeling and making a gameloop (in game NPC behavior, purchase system, HUD/UI placement etc.).  
  
I modeled my little world, and now I started modeling (with AI) my main antagonist and will model other NPCs. I've been seeing so many harsh comments about using AI in your project and some refunds about using AI. I'm not worried about refunds (bc I'm developing a Roblox game), and I can't help but think:  
  
 "What if people just hate my game bc of AI usage and never play my game? What if I'm working for something that will never be played or loved by a community."

Currently, I have a budget of 80$ a month (I'm a student at college, and my only income is coming from my family), so I can't just dump some thousands of dollars to model my NPCs, paint some paintings for my game, or write some code for my game.

I'm using Google AI Pro for 20$ a month and just bought a subscription from [Meshy.AI](http://Meshy.AI) for 10$.

Should I be worried about reviews, or id;k it's just... these kinds of people make me feel guilty about using AI. Without AI, I wasn't able to go that far.

What do you think, and what should I do? Thank you for your interest in advance. Have a wonderful day and nice developments.
